packageRules.description: Group all npm updates into one PR
Group all GitHub Actions updates into one PR

typescript-eslint has no TS 7 support yet (typescript-eslint#10940) — the `typescript` dep stays 6.x for the linter's API while `@typescript/native` (alias) tracks 7.x for the tsc binary. Drop this rule when typescript-eslint announces TS 7 support.
